name: The Pale Knight is Dead
description: As the Pale Knight falls, his true identity is revealed, and the Lord of the Feast's bizarre fixation on humanity is exposed. The loss of an embodiment is not enough to destroy a Noble, but the shame will linger for millenia, and his season will fade from the world for a long time indeed.
